environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'backend-services'. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service on port 3000 with no ingress controller. Other services in the mesh (including the public-facing API gateway in namespace 'gateway') can reach this service directly via Kubernetes DNS (user-service.backend-services.svc.cluster.local:3000). No Istio sidecar injection is configured for the cluster. The API gateway forwards user search requests with query parameters directly to this service without additional validation.

config.ingress: none - accessed via in-cluster gateway service
